notes.subject: amah
notes.rationale: אמה ke tekanyo e tswang koana (lekono); e ngotwe ka modumo wa Seheberu, eseng 'cubit'

notes.subject: קדמה מזרחה
notes.rationale: Seheberu se bolela 'bochabela' kabelo-pedi — peptide e bolela bocha/bochabela, mizracha peleho ya letsatsi; diphuthelwana tse pedi di bolokwa

notes.subject: ⟨amah⟩
notes.rationale: Sesotho se hloka sebopeho se hlakileng sa tekanyo; 'amah' e ngotwe ka masakana

notes.subject: bophara ba lebala
notes.rationale: Direto tsa kaho: bophara ba lehlakore la bochabela la lebala, masome a hlano a amah

translation: Mme bophara ba lebala, ka lehlakoreng la bochabela, ka bochabela, bo tla ba ⟨amah⟩ e masome a hlano.
